summary: rwc-client preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` downloads a Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`, extracts and chmods it executable in a temp directory, and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')])` against a bundled 727 KB file. `math_init.js` is a `// @bun @bun-cjs` file whose entire body is a single obfuscated blob (large numeric/string-literal array with a shift-decoder function and `_0x`-style hex identifiers), making the executed behavior opaque. The package presents itself as a Vue-based web chat client, which has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate runtime and execute an obfuscated bundle at install time. The alternate-runtime invocation also causes the payload to run outside the Node interpreter that most install-time scanners observe.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
